name: modern
label: Modern
css: .style-modern { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #553F83) 0%, var(--slide-primary, #553F83) 100%); width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; position: relative; font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', serif; color: var(--slide-text, #ffffff); overflow: hidden; } .style-modern::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%); pointer-events: none; } .style-modern .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 24px; max-width: 90%; z-index: 1; } .style-modern .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; max-width: 85%; z-index: 1; } .style-modern .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; z-index: 0; } .style-modern .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; opacity: 0.9; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-modern { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); color: var(--slide-text, #ffffff); } .slide-code.style-modern .hook { color: #ffffff; } .slide-code.style-modern .text { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); } .slide-code.style-modern .step { opacity: 0.1; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); } .slide-code.style-modern .brand { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); } .slide-insight.style-modern { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #111111 0%, #1f1f1f 100%); color: var(--slide-text, #ffffff); } .slide-insight.style-modern .insight-text { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #ffffff; max-width: 80%; margin: auto; text-align: center; z-index: 1; position: relative; } .slide-insight.style-modern .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #553F83); margin-bottom: 32px; } .slide-insight.style-modern .text { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); font-size: 44px; } .slide-insight.style-modern .step { opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-modern .brand { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); }
